43771.subject: Technical Drawing
43771.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
43771.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center, draw an arc above and below AB with radius > 30 mm.
3. With B as center, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

43772.subject: Technical Drawing
43772.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with side length 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
43772.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius = 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F around the circumference.
4. Join the points to form the hexagon.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

43773.subject: Technical Drawing
43773.question_text: Construct an external tangent to two circles of radii 20 mm and 30 mm, with centers 70 mm apart. Show all construction lines.
43773.explanation:
1. Draw the two circles with centers O1 and O2, radii 20 mm and 30 mm, respectively.
2. Draw a line joining O1 and O2.
3. With O2 as center, draw a circle of radius 30 mm - 20 mm = 10 mm.
4. Construct a tangent from O1 to this new circle.
5. Extend the tangent to meet the larger circle.
6. Draw a parallel line through O1 to form the external tangent.
7. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

43774.subject: Technical Drawing
43774.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given isometric block (dimensions: 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm) in first-angle orthographic projection. Include all hidden details.
43774.explanation:
1. Draw the front view (40 mm × 20 mm) showing height and length.
2. Draw the top view (40 mm × 30 mm) showing length and depth.
3. Draw the right-side view (30 mm × 20 mm) showing depth and height.
4. Include hidden lines for internal details.
5. Label all views and dimensions clearly.

43775.subject: Technical Drawing
43775.question_text: Given the front and top views of an object in first-angle projection, draw the missing right-side view. Include all hidden details.
43775.explanation:
1. Analyze the front and top views to determine the object's shape.
2. Project lines from the front and top views to construct the right-side view.
3. Include hidden lines for internal features.
4. Label all views and dimensions clearly.

43776.subject: Technical Drawing
43776.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object (cut along the vertical centerline) in first-angle projection. Include all visible and hidden details.
43776.explanation:
1. Identify the cutting plane along the vertical centerline.
2. Draw the sectional front view, showing internal details.
3. Hatch the cut surfaces at 45°.
4. Include all visible and hidden lines.
5. Label the sectional view clearly.

43777.subject: Technical Drawing
43777.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with dimensions 50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm. Include all visible edges.
43777.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Mark the dimensions along the axes: 50 mm (length), 30 mm (width), and 20 mm (height).
3. Complete the isometric box by joining the points.
4. Include all visible edges.
5. Label the isometric view clearly.

43778.subject: Technical Drawing
43778.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a square pyramid with base side 30 mm and slant height 50 mm. Show all construction lines.
43778.explanation:
1. Draw the base of the pyramid (30 mm × 30 mm).
2. Calculate the true length of the slant edge.
3. Draw the development by constructing four isosceles triangles with base = 30 mm and slant height = 50 mm.
4. Join the triangles to form the lateral surface.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

43779.subject: Technical Drawing
43779.question_text: Dimension the given orthographic views (front and top) of a simple bracket. Follow standard dimensioning conventions.
43779.explanation:
1. Identify all features requiring dimensioning (e.g., holes, slots, overall sizes).
2. Place dimensions outside the views where possible.
3. Use extension lines and dimension lines correctly.
4. Include diameter symbols for holes and radius symbols for arcs.
5. Ensure dimensions are clear and non-redundant.

43780.subject: Technical Drawing
43780.question_text:
Using a CAD software, draw the front view of a flange with the following specifications:
- Outer diameter: 100 mm
- Inner diameter: 60 mm
- 4 holes of diameter 10 mm equally spaced on a 80 mm PCD.
Save the drawing as a DXF file and label all features.
43780.explanation:
1. Draw the outer circle (100 mm diameter).
2. Draw the inner circle (60 mm diameter).
3. Calculate the positions of the 4 holes on the 80 mm PCD.
4. Draw the holes using the circle tool.
5. Label all features (e.g., diameters, PCD).
6. Save the file in DXF format.
